steps.action: Wikidata item page, 'coordinate location' statement 46°4'0.91"N, 11°7'20.78"E with a small Trento map, in view mode
clicks 'edit' on the statement; the value field opens and a popup 'will be displayed as:' with a map appears under it
clicks the '+' (zoom in) button in the popup map; a tooltip appears on it
clicks 'cancel', the statement returns to view mode (00:07.0)
clicks 'edit' again; the popup with the map opens again (00:08.2)
clicks the '-' (zoom out) button in the popup map

actual: Each click on a zoom button closes the map popup instead of zooming: after '+' at 00:04.2 the popup fades at 00:04.5 and is gone at 00:04.8; after '-' at 00:10.2 it is gone at 00:10.5. The map scale never changes. The statement stays in edit mode (value field, publish/remove/cancel) after the popup closes.
decisive: 00:04.2 -> 00:04.8: the cursor presses the map '+' button and the whole 'will be displayed as' popup with the map disappears, map not zoomed
not_visible: what the author expected - the source only says there is a bug with the zoom button; 'map zooms and popup stays' is inferred
notes: 1280x720, 14 s, the popup and its zoom buttons are small; the close happens within about 0.3 s of the click. Two attempts: zoom in, then zoom out.
